binning: 40 equal bins in log(1 + surface_hit_records); horizontal ticks show raw records
cohort: all completed reference tasks, 512 source positions and 8 transport replicas; every file uses 500000 primaries
count_definition: All valid CSV data rows at all recorded boundaries (upper, lower, and side surfaces), including zero deposited energy if present; these are surface-hit records rather than distinct phonons or junction quasiparticles.
reproduction: After recovering the verified archive with records.recover_archive, select reference hit-file paths from candidate_tasks in its results.sqlite using candidate_id above, then run python -m figures.plot hits <reference-hit-directory> --output figures/surface_hits_events500000_reference.png --counts <counts.csv> --log-x --bins 40 --title "Reference at 20 mK: 512 sites × 8 replicas, 500,000 primaries/file"
csv_path_definition: path names are relative to the verified study archive, not temporary extraction paths
surface_classification: upper: z = +262.5 micrometers; lower: z = -262.5 micrometers; side: |x| = 5 millimeters or |y| = 5 millimeters; classify upper/lower before sides at edges, with 10 nanometer tolerance.
reproduction_from_counts:
python - <<'PY'
import csv
from figures.plot import plot_hit_histogram
with open('figures/surface_hits_events500000_reference.csv', newline='') as handle:
    rows = [{'path': row['path'], 'surface_hit_records': int(row['surface_hit_records'])} for row in csv.DictReader(handle)]
report = {'files': rows, 'n_files': len(rows), 'surface_hit_records': sum(row['surface_hit_records'] for row in rows)}
plot_hit_histogram(report, 'figures/surface_hits_events500000_reference.png', bins=40, log_x=True,
                   title='Reference at 20 mK: 512 sites × 8 replicas, 500,000 primaries/file')
PY
